ideas.pitch: An autonomous data engineering agent that detects pipeline anomalies, traces lineage, and auto-generates verified repairs.
ideas.title: DataLine-DS: Autonomous Data Lineage & Incident Repair Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the grand-prize-winning agentic data lineage pattern which deeply appeals to data science and engineering judges from Nexus-DS.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered monitoring platform combining satellite imagery analysis with IoT sensor streams to flag industrial zoning and environmental violations.
ideas.title: EcoWatch-DS: Satellite & IoT Industrial Compliance Monitoring
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the runner-up GeoNex-ATLAS pattern of hard-to-solve enterprise monitoring that appeals directly to industrial domain experts.

ideas.pitch: An XGBoost-powered predictive dashboard for patient readmission risk featuring real-time SHAP values for immediate clinical explainability.
ideas.title: HealthReadmit-X: Clinical Explainability Dashboard for Patient Outcomes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses the proven first-place winning formula of high-accuracy tabular machine learning combined with transparent SHAP explanations.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent operational dashboard that isolates NGINX and server log anomalies using fast machine learning and closed-loop mitigation.
ideas.title: LogSentinel-DS: Multi-Agent NGINX & Infrastructure Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines winning anomaly detection algorithms with a fully functional live demo that judges can interact with instantly.

ideas.pitch: A solo-built or team-engineered evaluation toolkit that automatically detects, explains, and provides mitigation strategies for biased machine learning models.
ideas.title: FairLens-DS: Automated Bias Detection & Mitigation for ML Pipelines
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles model fairness head-on, matching a proven 3rd place winning pattern that addresses ethical and societal AI challenges.
